goal: Test whether historical 5/6 events contain a reproducible strictly prior-data cutoff-boundary effect that remains after matched-cost null testing, without re-running prior omitted-winner rescue families.

scope.nearFullDefinition: exactly 5 of 6 main numbers inside the frozen top-8 pool
scope.boundaryCase: the missing sixth winner is ranked 9 or 10 by the frozen pre-draw ranker
scope.deepCase: the missing sixth winner is ranked 11 or worse by the frozen pre-draw ranker
scope.newQuestionOnly: Is boundary-rank distance itself prospectively informative after conditioning on the frozen baseline?

forbiddenRepeats: reuse target outcomes to choose boundary width
re-run rank9_drop8, rank10_drop8 or rank9_drop7 as v314 actions
antiDuplicateGuard.requiredNovelty: Boundary-rank distance is frozen pre-holdout and tested only as a separate prospective covariate against matched-cost nulls and prior frozen baselines.

frozenRankerArtifact.frozenConfigs: all 12 v138/v141 configurations exactly as previously frozen; no configuration selection or retuning is permitted in v314

frozenTicketCutoff.actionPolicy: audit only; v314 does not alter the pool or perform add/drop rescue actions

discoveryWindow.note: All previously exposed historical results, including the old 2018-2026 v138/v141 holdout, are treated as discovery evidence for v314 and cannot be reused as fresh validation.

holdoutWindow.note: A draw is eligible only if its ranking/pool/config evidence was frozen before the official result became available.

matchedCostNullSpec.conditioning: condition on the same frozen ranker/config and on exactly five winning numbers falling inside the same frozen top-8 pool
matchedCostNullSpec.nullMissingRank: under the matched conditional null, the missing sixth winner rank is sampled uniformly from ranks 9 through 49 while the frozen pool, ranker and 14 EUR theoretical cost remain unchanged

freeze.multiplicityMethod: Holm-Bonferroni family-wise error control at alpha=0.05 across the 12 frozen ranker configurations
freeze.successMetric: primary: prospective boundary-enrichment rate among eligible 5/6 events, where boundary means missing-winner rank 9 or 10; success requires positive enrichment over the matched conditional null, Holm-adjusted p<0.05, lower 95% confidence bound above the null boundary probability, and no post-freeze retuning

inference.primaryTest: exact binomial test per frozen configuration against p0=2/41, with Holm correction across 12 configurations; deterministic matched-null permutation is a robustness check
secondaryMetrics: full missing-winner rank distribution from 9 through 49
mean and median distance from cutoff 8
temporal stability across prospectively completed chronological blocks
inference.promotionPolicy: A positive v314 result establishes only a prospective boundary-distance signal. It does not authorize a rescue substitution, predictive jackpot claim, or real-money play. Any action rule would require a new preregistered experiment on later untouched data.
prospectiveFreezeEvidenceRequired: complete ranked list or immutable rank artifact

successGate: Boundary-rank distance must improve reproducibly on the matched conditional null in prospective data and survive Holm correction; discovery-only 5/6 events do not count.
failureGate: Archive as negative or duplicate if the boundary effect vanishes prospectively, fails corrected null testing, requires post-hoc boundary changes, or merely reconstructs v141/v142/v144/v145/v146.
scientificNote: The previously exposed 2018-2026 interval is explicitly not reused as a fresh v314 holdout. Validation starts prospectively on 2026-08-18. v314 is an audit of boundary distance only; it performs no rescue action.
